findings: Mareike Conrad,John Lynch,Glen Mittelhauser actual photos: sprawling fine shoots with small trifoliate leaves and groups of few yellow pea flowers; giant single terminal bloom rejected. Current seeds1,4,7 and all36contact-sheet panels visually inspected. Six rising/spreading shoots carry small trifoliate leaves and few yellow terminal pea flowers;15–30cm forms retain original real dimensions. Leaflets and pea petal shapes merge at25mm. Accepted as coarse stylized spring source; user endorsement remains separate.
